intervention_names: Drug: obicetrapib 10 mg + obicetrapib/evolocumab 140 mg Q 2 weeks
arm_groups.label: obicetrapib/evolocumab combination

brief_summary:
The goal of this open label 16 week trial is to evaluate Lp(a) levels for patients with elevated Lp(a) being treated with obicetrapib and obiceptrapib/evolocumab

Patients will:

Have baseline Lp(a) tested at randomization Take 10mg/dL obiceptrapib daily for 8 weeks and have Lp(a) tested at Week 8 Take 10 mg/dL obicetrapib daily/evolocumab 140 every other week for 8 weeks and have Lp(a) retested at Week 16
brief_title: Impact of Obicetrapib and Obicetrapib Plus Repatha on Lp(a) Levels

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Lp(a): \>=50 mg/dL (\>=125 nmol/L) for cohort 1 (FILLED) and Lp(a) \>= 20 mg/dL (\>= 50 nmol/L) to \<50 mg/dL (\< 125 nmol/L) for cohort 2
* LDL-C \>70 mg/dL
* TG \< 400mg/dL (\<4.52 mmol/L)

Exclusion Criteria:

* HbA1c\>=10 or FPG \>=270 mg/dL
* CV events within 3 months of screen

interventions.name: obicetrapib 10 mg + obicetrapib/evolocumab 140 mg Q 2 weeks

official_title: A Phase 2 Study to Evaluate the Effect of Obicetrapib Alone and in Combination With Evolocumab (Repatha®) on Lipoprotein (a) in Patients With Mild Dyslipidemia: The VINCENT Study

primary_outcomes.measure: To evaluate the effect of evolocumab in combination with obicetrapib on lipoprotein (a) (Lp[a]).
primary_outcomes.time_frame: 16 weeks from baseline; 8 weeks on combination therapy
